thread:
Elaine: Thanks everyone for joining the all-hands — starting this thread for follow-ups on the people plan and team maps. drop quick q's and we'll answer.
Sophie: Thanks! Can you clarify which functions are prioritized for new hires in Q3? I heard platform + runtime but want specifics.
Jamal: Priorities are: 1) Serving runtime performance (latency/cost), 2) Infra reliability/oncall automation, 3) DevEx/SDKs for adoption. We'll bias hires toward runtime + infra but keep 1-2 DevEx roles depending on pipeline health.
Sophie: Are those hires mostly ICs or manager roles?
Jamal: Mostly ICs at senior+ levels for Q3. We expect 1 manager hire only if a current manager transitions out. Manager hires will be tactical and vetted by hiring committee.
Praveen: For people on the existing teams: if my team gets split, what's the plan for reporting lines and immediate oncall responsibilities?
Elaine: We'll publish a short org map doc by next Wed with reporting lines. Oncall: no immediate reshuffle for 2 weeks — we want continuity. If a shift is needed, we'll post a migration plan + overlap shadow shifts.
Sam: To add: transfers are encouraged. We will prioritize internal mobility over external hires for backfills where skills match. Managers should flag any internal candidates to People Ops and the hiring partner.
Maria: For recruiting bandwidth: we can open up to 8 reqs for Q3. Channel heads should submit role briefs by EOD Fri. I'll host a 30-min sync Thurs to triage.
Sophie: Any changes to the IC ladder/levels with the reorg? I have folks asking about leveling calibration.
Jamal: No wholesale ladder change this quarter. We'll run a calibration session in 2 weeks to make sure promotions/levels map cleanly to the new org. If anyone sees a mismatch, DM me and cc Elaine.
Praveen: Will there be a hiring freeze at any point during the transition?
Elaine: No freeze planned. We are doing prioritized hiring — some teams will get greenlight earlier than others. Approvals will reflect priority and budget buckets.
Sophie: Budget buckets? can you share a small breakdown?
Elaine: Quick snippet:
```
Bucket A: Runtime + Infra — 40% of Q3 new headcount
Bucket B: DevEx + Product infra — 30%
Bucket C: Customer & Solutions — 20%
Buffer: 10% (float / critical reroutes)
```
Sophie: Helpful, thanks.
Sam: Also note enterprise customers are driving a few Dedicated/Private feature asks. A couple of those roles are cross-functional (eng + infra + solutions).
Praveen: If I want to move teams, what's the process? Application? informal chat?
Elaine: Start with an informal chat with the receiving manager + your manager. If both agree, submit an internal transfer form (link will be posted) and Recruiting will own timeline. Transfers are prioritized for open reqs.
Maria: I'll post the form and a short checklist after the Thurs sync. Recruiter-bot will remind managers 48h before deadlines.
Recruiter-bot: Reminder scheduled: submit role briefs by Fri EOD — channel: #all-hands
Sophie: Timeline for org chart publish again?
Elaine: Draft map Wed, feedback window Thu-Fri, final publish next Mon. We'll include role owners and onboarding overlap notes.
Praveen: Thanks — last q: will this impact comp bands or promo cycles?
Sam: Promo cycles stay on schedule. Comp band review is a separate annual process; no ad-hoc changes tied to this reorg. Any exceptions will be handled case-by-case by People Ops.
Sophie: Great, that clears a lot. I'll bring a couple IC candidates to Maria after the Thurs sync.
Jamal: Thanks all. If anything urgent, ping me and I'll carve time after the calibration meeting.
Elaine: Appreciate it — closing the thread for now, will reopen if more follow-ups come in. :handshake:
